jobs.title: Cambridge Information Group Inc: Front-End Developer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY
URL: https://edconic.com/

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000–$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

 

Apply Here

jobs.title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sarasota, FL
URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/

SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS
  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse
  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools
  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager
  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)
  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.
  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.
  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.
  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.
  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.
  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.
  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.
  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.
  • PHP development experience.
  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.
  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.
  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.
  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.
  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.
  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.
  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.
  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

jobs.title: Storyblok: Senior Database Reliability Engineer I - Germany/Austria/UK
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it.

This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation.

You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team.

We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room.

 

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Database platform (approx. 60%)

  • Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths.
  • Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions.
  • Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene.
  • Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path.
  • Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require.
  • Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability.

Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%)

  • Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes.
  • Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them.
  • Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant.

Team, incidents, and collaboration

  • Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence.
  • Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person.
  • Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS

Required — PostgreSQL depth

  • 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning.
  • Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services.
  • Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables.
  • Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies.

Required — Infrastructure and ways of working

  • Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS.
  • Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation).
  • Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists.
  • Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued).
  • Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load.
  • Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows.
  • Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional).

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here.

All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (storyblok.com).

Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

jobs.title: Collibra: Manager, Professional Services Federal
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Joining Collibra’s Professional Services Team

At Collibra Public Sector (CPS), the Manager, Federal Professional Services is responsible for leading all services roles and functions to ensure the long-term success, adoption, and satisfaction of government clients. The role drives a cohesive customer journey, aligns services delivery with other CPS delivery to mission outcomes, and ensures operational excellence across the entire customer lifecycle. This role safeguards account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction by proactively identifying and mitigating technical risk, coordinating services engagements, and building operational frameworks for GTM clarity and alignment amongst the services teams.

Federal Engagement Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

Services Management

  • Manage services operations and resources, including Engagement Manager and Solution Architects, ensuring timely and successful project execution and value delivery.
  • Manages professional service team in respect to project milestones, delivery and goals.
  • Responsible for team utilization and revenue optimization.
  • Drive operational excellence in services delivery.
  • Monitor performance to ensure teams are performing within expectations and achieving high levels of project success.
  • Collaborate on GTM strategy for CPS Services, helping shape how services is positioned, sold, and delivered throughout the customer journey.
  • Guide sales enablement and customer-facing messaging, ensuring services' value proposition is clear, consistent, and aligned with customer needs.
  • Evaluate pricing and packaging strategies for new and existing offerings.
  • Identify expansion opportunities and influence sales motions with timely insights.
  • Contribute to strategic deal support, partnering with Sales and Finance on high-impact renewals, expansions, and new business that include services offerings.
  • Engages with new / prospective customers to identify business challenges and opportunities, recommend solutions / solution enhancements and propose a high-level delivery roadmap based on expected business value. 

Customer Project Oversight

  • Guide project team members through scoping and level of effort estimates.
  • Ensure effective controls are in place and regularly updated in order to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle including: project plans, status reports, time recording, resource planning, and first value forecasting.
  • Advises implementation project teams and customers on milestone achievement, issue resolution and change management.
  • Ensures effective controls are in place to monitor the full implementation project lifecycle.
  • Develops and tracks overall project success, customer satisfaction, and quality of delivery. 
  • Maintains and nurtures consultative relationships with key customer leadership and decision-makers. 
  • Establishes and ensures effective execution of solution delivery accelerating the customer's time to value.
  • Perform post-project reviews to ensure achievement of business objectives.

 

Customer Journey Mapping and Operational improvement

  • Assist with the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Implement frameworks to continuously assess services customer value realization, using structured feedback and data to refine operational and delivery models.
  • Drive maturity in delivery practices, tooling, and customer engagement models.
  • Standardize and operationalize proactive engagement workflows in relation to the technical teams (e.g., onboarding, QBRs, Value delivery, and Renewal motions).
  • Identify trends and opportunities for improvement within the services organization, and implement solutions to enhance customer success and team efficiency.
  • Captures lessons learned and ensures their application to future project planning and process improvement.   

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Engagement Managers and Solution Architects, empowering them to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, high performance, and customer obsession.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent with expertise in government operations.
  • Cultivate an environment that fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
  • Ensures timely and effective communication of departmental goals and objectives internally within the department and more broadly with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Develop and implement strategies to achieve team and individual performance goals, exceeding customer, organization and company expectations.
  • Ensures that training, coaching and mentoring programs are developed, implemented and effective for the team.

 

Customer Risk Prevention, Assessment & Management

  • Build and manage frameworks for early identification of at-risk projects or customers in relation to services engagements.
  • Act as a management escalation point for the Services team encountering project obstacles, and liaise with internal teams for resolution.
  • Support employees in raising issues associated with customer and project risk.
  • Partner with Sales and the other technical GTM teams to identify and mitigate renewal or churn risk.
  • Support proactive risk reviews for strategic/enterprise accounts.
  • Manages pivotal customer issues and concerns through the team, directly handling escalated issues.
  • Drive customer project At-Risk post-mortems and ensure preventive actions are implemented.

 

You have:

  • A U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil as the role supports the U.S. government.
  • 5+ years of experience in consulting supporting U.S. federal agencies.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience managing services teams in the support of U.S. federal agencies.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong leadership skills collaborating with Sr Executives on a frequent basis.
  • Knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.
  • Have previous military experience.
  • Hold an active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).
  • Knowledgeable of at least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management.
  • An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.
  • Experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.
  • An understanding of APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments. 
  • An understanding of data warehousing, ETL, data integration.

You are

  • An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.
  • Self-starting and interested in learning new software.
  • Able to lead Senior Level customer discussions representing CPS and services engagements.

Measures of Success

  • Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to
  • Clearly understand the roles and responsibilities of the reporting employees and the account assignments.
  • Present the services offering, understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.
  • Present the Customer Journey framework, understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.
  • Clearily understand the roles and responsibilities of all delivery personnel including an Engagement Manager, Solution Architect, Account Program Manager, Premium Support Engineer, Sales Engineer and Account Executive.
  • Within the first 60 days of employment
  • Navigate Salesforce including opportunities, utilization, projects, and quotes.
  • Identify customers and services engagements at Risk and build a plan to remediate.
  • Identify process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.
  • Present the services offering to a customer.
  • Within the first 90 days of employment be able to
  • Advise Sales on proposed services engagements.
  • Build Salesforce reports for visibility into Services engagements including utilization.
  • Build playbooks to address process gaps and inefficiencies within the services organization.
  • Execute remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales, support, and technical teams.
  • Understand and convey to customers how Collibra's suite product capabilities and the projects being delivered provide value to customers.

 

 

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $128,000 - 160,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

 

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

jobs.title: Luminize: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist / Interviewer (USD Contract)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Belgrade, Serbia
URL: https://luminize.com

🚀 Be the First Conversation in Every Great Hire

📍 Role: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist / Interviewer (USD Contract) 
📍 Location: Belgrade, Serbia 
     Work From Home / Remote - Serbia
      Offshore, Full-time, US hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

At Luminize, we help brands win. As a top 5 Amazon seller in the US by volume, we're growing fast, and great hiring starts with a great first screen.

We are looking for a Candidate Screening Specialist to own the qualification step between application and recruiter. You will review inbound applicants, run structured screening interviews, and keep clean, consistent records in our applicant tracking system (ATS). You will screen for roles across our San Diego corporate team and our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. This is a focused role. Your job is to hold a consistent, fair bar across high volume screens so our recruiters spend their time on candidates who are truly ready.

If you take pride in sound judgment, clear notes, and doing the details right every time, we would love to meet you!

🎯 What You'll Be Doing

  • Review inbound applications and resumes against role requirements, keeping the applicant queue current with no aged applications
  • Conduct structured phone and video screening interviews using an approved screening guide and scorecard
  • Write concise, evidence-based screen notes in ATS, working from meeting transcripts
  • Make advance or decline decisions at the screening stage, and apply an accurate reason code to every candidate you disposition
  • Flag strong candidates who may fit a different open role, and escalate patterns such as off-profile applicants or screening guides that don't reflect the role
  • Support general upkeep of the ATS so job posts, application questions, candidate emails, and reporting stay accurate

🏆 What Success Looks Like

  • Recruiters consistently agree with the candidates you advance. Quality matters more than volume.
  • Every applicant is reviewed promptly, and every screen is documented the same day
  • Every dispositioned candidate carries a clear reason code, giving our team reliable hiring data
  • Candidates leave your screen with an accurate picture of the role and a professional impression of Luminize

✅ What You Bring

  • 3+ years recent experience conducting candidate screens and structured interviews
  • US-market recent recruiting experience
  • Fluent professional English required, written and spoken with the ability to build rapport quickly
  • Experience with an ATS (i.e JazzHR)
  • Familiarity with AI and video interview platforms (i.e. Fathom)
  • Ability to assess candidates against a defined scorecard rather than personal impression, and to accept calibration feedback
  • Working knowledge of EEO and non-discrimination principles in screening, including topics that should not be asked
  • Concise written assessment skills: you document evidence, not impressions
  • Strong attention to detail and the discipline to keep records accurate under time pressure
  • Discretion with confidential candidate information
  • Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday
  • Reliable high-speed internet with backup power, and a quiet workspace suitable for video interviews
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

jobs.title: Antora Energy: Senior Power Procurement Manager
jobs.description:

URL: https://www.antora.com

Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

 
 
Position Summary

 

The Senior Power Procurement Manager will lead utility tariff and power purchase negotiations from first engagement through execution, owning a portfolio of medium- to high-complexity deals across one or more ISOs/RTOs. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports: the person will draft and negotiate term sheets and definitive agreements, build and pressure-test deal models, coordinate cross-functional inputs, and serve as the day-to-day point of contact with utility counterparts. They will lead complex, multi-site negotiations, pilot new commercial constructs, and are expected to become Antora's recognized expert for a region.

 

 

Roles & Responsibilities

 

  • Deal Execution & Negotiation

    • Lead day-to-day negotiations and the overall close plan for utility tariffs, energy service agreements, and PPAs.
    • Draft and negotiate term sheets; lead definitive agreement negotiations alongside counsel; negotiate standard tariff rate changes per playbook.
    • Support capacity and power sales origination, including preparing and negotiating MOUs, term sheets, and off-take agreements with utilities, hyperscalers, and other large-load customers.
    • Help shape deal structures that fit Antora's unique load profile.
    • Coordinate Finance, Legal, Policy, Business Development, and Engineering inputs; run cross-functional working sessions to align positions, timelines, and technical constraints.
    • Own financial model architecture for deals: select modeling approaches, set key assumptions, run sensitivities and stress tests, validate inputs, and QA models built by others.

    Utility & Counterparty Relationships

    • Serve as the primary point of contact with utility managers and directors.
    • Build deep regional knowledge of priority ISOs/RTOs, utilities, and tariff landscapes, growing into a go-to resource for at least one region.
    • Partner with Business Development to qualify and advance opportunities, ensuring smooth handoffs from early engagement to active negotiation.

    Regulatory Support & Team Contribution

    • Support regulatory work by drafting comments, exhibits, and data responses; may represent Antora in staff workshops and by testifying in regulatory forums.
    • Surface patterns across deals (common counterparty objections, emerging tariff structures, regulatory shifts) and propose playbook language updates for senior review.
    • Informally mentor junior team members on models, redlines, and negotiation prep.
 
Key Qualifications

 

  • 6–12+ years of experience in power procurement, energy origination, utility negotiations, or energy commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated deal track record of leading successful Power Procurement Agreement or Electric Service Agreement negotiations.
  • Solid working knowledge of utility tariff design, wholesale power markets, and the commercial mechanics of how large loads contract for energy and grid services, with depth in at least one region or ISO.
  • Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating term sheets and definitive agreements alongside counsel.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, ability to build, stress-test, and QA deal models and translate results into negotiation positions.
  • Sound commercial judgment within guardrails: knowing which terms to hold, which to trade, and when a deviation needs to be escalated.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to write decision memos and present recommendations to internal leadership with minimal editing.
 
Additional Qualifications Desired

 

  • Experience with energy storage, thermal storage, or flexible load commercial structures.
  • Exposure to capacity sales or hyperscaler energy procurement.
  • Experience in high-growth or start-up environments where commercial processes are still being built.
  • Working relationships with utility procurement/rates teams and ISO/RTO stakeholders in MISO, SPP, ERCOT, or PJM.
  • Experience supporting regulatory proceedings (comments, data responses, staff workshops).

 

Work Location:  Remote, USA

Salary Range:  $158,000 USD - $225,000 USD

Salary Basis:  Annual

The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

Job Description:

The Proactive Team Network Administrator serves as a senior technical resource, responsible for managing escalations, driving automation, and ensuring high-quality proactive service delivery. This role focuses on reducing operational noise through automation, maintaining robust documentation, and mentoring technicians to elevate technical performance and client satisfaction.

Job Responsibilities:

Proactive Monitoring & Alerts

  • Design, implement, and refine processes for handling proactive service alerts (patching, disk space, antivirus, hardware/software alerts).

Mentorship & Escalation Support

Automation & Scripting

Documentation

Collaboration & Strategy

jobs.title: Volga Partners: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners

AI Engineer | India 

Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 
 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions.
  • Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity.
  • Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation.
  • Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption.
  • Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations.

Production & Optimization 

  • Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch.
  • Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users.

Collaboration

  • Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making.
  • Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions.

Research & Experimentation 

  • Read and evaluate ML research papers.  
  • Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable.  
  • Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems.  
  • Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.  

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

  • Engineering leadership and product teams.
  • Software engineers and backend developers.
  • Global AI research and development teams.

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

  • Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact.
  • Translate research into practical engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • Document and share technical knowledge for scalability.
  • Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities.

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 
 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production.
  • Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction.
  • Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging.
  • Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras.
  • Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs.
  • Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design.
  • Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods.
  • SQL database knowledge.
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure.
  • Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results.

Compensation & Benefits 

  • Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.  
  • Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.  
  • 90-day probationary period.  
  • Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:  
    • Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.  
    • Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.  
    • Career growth and professional development opportunities. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/volga-partners-ai-ml-engineer-production-ai-llm-systems-india

This is a hands-on build role, and acts as the connective tissue to our cross-functional GTM team. You will work daily with Sales and Partnerships, because the programs you build feed their pipeline across mid-market brands, enterprise order management, and 3PL.

About the role

Pipe17’s Order Operations Platform is the connected OMS that unifies orders, inventory, products and fulfillment across selling channels (DTC, B2B, retail and agentic), ERPs and fulfillment locations. We sell a technical product to operators, their bosses and the rest of the enterprise buying group, and generic marketing does not work on them.

We need someone who can build the systems that put the right message in front of the right account at the right moment, then run those systems without babysitting. You are part engineer, part marketer: comfortable in APIs, automation platforms, and LLM tooling, and equally comfortable judging whether a play will actually grow qualified pipeline. You will be the only person in this function, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, with the latitude to build what does not exist yet.

What you'll do

Run account-based marketing execution.

  • Build the named account lists for our enterprise and 3PL programs, and map the people inside each account.
  • Keep account evidence current, built with agents rather than by hand: what each account runs, who runs it, what it costs them, and what changed.
  • Run the mechanics: multi-touch sequences, executive outreach, dinner and event invitations, gifting, and follow-up.
  • Own event and conference follow-up as a system. Target list and meetings booked before anyone travels, follow-up inside 72 hours.
  • Give Sales and Partnerships what they need to work each account, when they need it.

Build custom nurtures. Replace the single nurture track with custom paths, where treatment rises with intent and decays with time. High-intent visitors get a human fast, light engagement gets agent-drafted outreach keyed to what they did, and stalled or previously-too-small accounts get re-scored and re-contacted on a schedule.

Own HubSpot. Own the roadmap and the admin. Fix the data model so it matches how we actually sell across three segments, clean up source attribution so we can say what produced pipeline, and build reporting the business trusts. Keep the stack small. We are not looking for someone who adds tools.

Build the outbound engine.

  • Build automated outbound end to end: signal detection, enrichment, sequencing, reply handling, and CRM sync, using the tools we have in house today (HubSpot, Clay, Propensity, Artisan, Gong).
  • Detect the events that mean an account is in play: a replatform, an ERP migration, a 3PL change, a new channel, a second warehouse, a bad peak season, a new operations or technology leader.
  • Use LLMs and agents to personalize at volume, grounded in real research about each account.
  • Make it run without babysitting, and make it measurable.

Must-have qualifications

  • 3+ years in marketing operations, demand gen operations, GTM operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company.
  • You have built an outbound engine from scratch, and can tell us what it produced in meetings or pipeline.
  • You have run account-based programs, including building the target list when it did not exist, and are familiar with implementing and enabling use of ABM platforms.
  • You have built custom nurtures with differentiated paths, and can show what they did to conversion.
  • Deep HubSpot. You have designed the data model around how a business sells, and you are happy doing the admin yourself.
  • You build. APIs, data manipulation, LLM tooling, and real depth in automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or Make. You can read API docs and debug when something breaks.
  • You did it unprompted. You saw the gap and shipped the fix before anyone asked.
  • Commercial instinct. You understand pipeline and conversion, and why reps ignore tools that technically work.
  • A doer. Comfortable as the only person in the function, with direct exposure to the founders.
  • Fluent in using AI to do the work, not just to talk about it.

Nice to have

  • Experience in ecommerce, retail technology, or logistics.
  • Enterprise account-based marketing into retail or supply chain buyers.
  • Agents or LLM workflows in production against a pipeline outcome.
  • Built the function from nothing at a Series A to C company.
  • Ran a long enterprise cycle and a fast mid-market cycle in the same system.
  • Supported a partner or channel motion, including partner-sourced attribution.

 

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and with Series A funding.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do: 

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For: 

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

 

Reports to: Director, Reseller Sales

Location:  Must live in the Southwest US.  IE: SoCal, Nevada or Arizona

Compensation:  $175,000 – $185,000 on target earnings with a 60/40 split plus equity

What You’ll Do: 

Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Development Specialist to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing new reseller partnerships in North America to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. This is a front-line, hunter role built for someone who lives to recruit, activate, and scale channel partners at pace. You’ll own the recruitment, onboarding, and early growth of new broad channel partners across the US who transact through distribution. Your mission is simple: find them, sign them, enable them, and drive revenue through their preferred distributor.

You’ll work closely with distribution partners, marketing, and the wider channel team to turn raw partner interest into productive, revenue-generating relationships.

Responsibilities:  

  • Proactively identify, recruit, and onboard new reseller partners (VARs, IT providers, etc) across North America who buy through distribution
  • Qualify prospective partners quickly and move fast from first contact to onboarding with a heavy focus on time-to-first-deal
  • Build a strong bench of net-new, first-time Huntress partners
  • Drive partner recruitment and growth through Huntress distribution relationships, working hand-in-hand with distribution partners to co-sell, co-market, and accelerate pipeline
  • Own the first 90–180 days of the partner journey
  • Ensure partners understand how to buy, quote, and transact efficiently via distribution
  • Deliver foundational enablement on Huntress value, positioning, and use cases
  • Identify expansion opportunities and hand off mature partners at the right time
  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers at reseller and distributor companies, ensuring they are actively promoting our products and addressing any concerns they may have
  • Provide resellers with the tools, resources, and ongoing training necessary to effectively present and sell our products to their customers
  • Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation
  • Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential
  • Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days, and other related conferences
  • Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring To The Team:  

  • 2-5+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner development, and/or distribution-led roles
  • Proven track record of partner recruitment or high-velocity sales
  • Experience working with US distribution (tech, security, SaaS, and/or Microsoft strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including different product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends, particularly in the SMB and Commercial customer segments
  • Proven track record of identifying, recruiting, and quickly activating resellers, including an understanding of partner dynamics and incentive structures. Existing key reseller relationships are highly preferred.
  • SMB and Commercial mindset with a bias for action and execution
  • Experience and knowledge of MSFT licensing and Security solutions are highly preferred
  • Confident, credible communicator who can open doors and build trust quickly with key decision makers at reseller companies and foster long-term partnerships
  • Comfortable working remotely and managing a wide geographic territory
  • Willingness to travel as needed  

What We Offer: 

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

The CSM is responsible for engaging Donorbox’s mid-tier customers and new CRM signups who have yet to interact with a company representative. This role bridges Customer Success, Community Engagement, and Growth—helping customers adopt key features, recognize value, and stay connected to Donorbox through education and proactive outreach. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Support, you will guide customers through onboarding and adoption, create and share helpful educational resources, and identify opportunities for expansion or deeper engagement to hand off to the Sales team. You’ll also support knowledge initiatives that strengthen the self-serve experience and community learning for all Donorbox users. This role is key to improving activation rates, increasing product adoption, and fostering stronger customer relationships across the Donorbox ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Manage relationships with mid-tier customers to ensure continued success and feature adoption.
  • Act as the first point of human contact for users who have not yet interacted with a representative.

  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities through customer usage analysis and pass qualified leads to Sales.
  • Partner with the Product and Customer Operations teams to surface insights, feedback, and improvement opportunities.
  • Foster community engagement through online events, user groups, newsletters, and in-app communications.
  • Maintain an understanding of new features and updates to share proactively with customers.
  • Track and report on key metrics such as activation rates, engagement levels, NPS/CSAT, and expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistent messaging, smooth customer handoffs, and a unified customer experience.

jobs.title: Buildkite: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://buildkite.com/home

About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

As a Senior CSM at Buildkite, you'll be a senior individual contributor responsible for driving measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of Buildkite’s Enterprise customers. You are the customer’s strategic partner in value realization - accountable for the adoption of Buildkite, the outcomes the customer achieves with it and the long-term health of the partnership.

You’ll co-own each account with an Account Executive. The AE drives the growth of the partnership and owns the commercial relationship. You own the value the customer gets from what they’ve already purchased. You’ll work alongside a Technical Account Manager, who leads technical advisory on the customer’s current solutions, while the AE partners with a Solutions Architect on what the customer is evaluating next. You and the AE both build relationships at every level of the customer’s organization, each at your own angle. 

You’ll join a small, senior team while Buildkite’s Customer Success function is maturing quickly and you’ll help shape the playbooks and operating model that come next. We are looking for someone who wants to improve the role, not just fill it. 

What You'll Do

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Post-Sale Ownership: Own the post-sale state of your named Enterprise accounts: health, adoption, retention and spotting expansion opportunities. You do this in partnership with your Account Executive, who owns the commercial side of the relationship. 
  • Value Realization: Drive measurable business outcomes from the Buildkite investment by aligning each account’s success plan to the customer’s core engineering and business goals.
  • Account Team Partnership: Work as one account team with your AE, TAM and Solutions Architect. Bring in Product, Support and Engineering when the account needs them, so the customer experiences one cohesive Buildkite. 
  • Cadence Design: Determine when and how to engage each account based on the value it returns to the customer — right-sizing engagement so every interaction earns its place on the customer’s calendar.
  • Operating Model Contribution: Help shape the playbooks, processes, and operating model of a maturing CS function — and mentor new team members as the team grows. 

Executive Influence and Customer Partnership

  • Executive Engagement: Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with customer C-suite, VP, Director, and program-owner stakeholders — including the executive sponsor accountable for the Buildkite investment.
  • Business Translation: Translate technical adoption and platform health into the business outcomes that matter to executive sponsors, and into the language they use with their own leadership.
  • Executive Business Reviews: Lead the EBR cadence with the AE and TAM — bringing the value narrative, customer readiness, and forward-looking strategy that keeps the partnership on track.
  • Customer Advocacy: Amplify the voice of the customer inside Buildkite, ensuring Product, Engineering, and Support stay focused on what matters most to the accounts you own.

Risk, Renewal, and Expansion Readiness

  • Account Health: Maintain a live view of technical, commercial, support, and relationship signals across your portfolio — surface risk early, mobilize the right Buildkite resources, and prevent escalation through proactive partnership.
  • Renewal Strategy: Partner with the Account Executive on renewal strategy by driving the value narrative, customer readiness, and account health that underpin every commercial conversation.
  • Expansion Sourcing: Identify and source expansion opportunities through the Customer-Sourced Qualified Lead (CSQL) process — turning customer outcomes into growth.
  • Onboarding: Partner with the Technical Account Manager on the first 90 days, and sustain the joint CSM/TAM cadence that drives customers from go-live to long-term value.

This Is You If...

  • You have 5+ years in Customer Success, strategic account management, or a senior post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company, owning Enterprise accounts as the person accountable for value, retention, and expansion
  • You bring direct experience at a CI/CD, DevOps, developer tools, or technical infrastructure SaaS company — enough domain fluency to navigate engineering conversations and the CI/CD problem space credibly, without trying to be the technical expert
  • You have a demonstrable track record of driving retention and expansion outcomes on a named Enterprise book
  • You communicate with exceptional executive presence — comfortable engaging VP, CTO, and C-suite stakeholders, and translating technical work into the business outcomes their leadership cares about
  • You're able to handle objections, navigate complicated discussions, and drive alignment across customer and internal stakeholders — with persistence in the face of adversity
  • You have experience orchestrating across Sales, Solutions, Support, Product, and Marketing to deliver a coherent customer experience across complex, multi-stakeholder accounts
  • You bring strong commercial instincts — you understand how your work connects to renewal health, churn risk, and expansion, and you operate effectively alongside AEs and Renewals
  • You're a strong autonomous operator who wants to help shape the role, not just fill it — you are comfortable improving the playbook as you run it and contributing to the operating model of a growing team. 

Bonus Points If...

  • Hands-on familiarity with Buildkite or comparable CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Harness, GitLab CI) — enough to navigate a customer’s CI/CD architecture conversation without needing translation
  • Experience partnering with Technical Account Managers or Solutions Architects in a model where the technical and relationship roles are explicitly separated
  • Familiarity with CS platforms (Vitally, Catalyst, Gainsight, Totango, or similar) and modern revenue stacks (Salesforce, Avoma, ChartMogul, or equivalent)
  • Background contributing to a CS function mature and scale, not just executing within an established one 

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 6 weeks a year, on top of a fully remote setup — great work doesn’t have to happen from one desk.
  • 20 days paid annual leave plus 10 days sick & carer's leave — actively encouraged, we want you to be at your best and time off is a part of that.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers (6 for secondary) — becoming a parent is life changing and we’re committed to supporting you and your family through it.
  • A remote-work allowance for home-office kit, co-working, or working elsewhere — we want you to have everything you need to be set up for success in your role.
  • Confidential EAP & mental health support — sometimes life gets hard. You should be able to access the resources and support you need.
  • Support for learning and growth — with time and budget for conferences, courses, and coaching so you have the opportunity to grow, improve your craft, and build mastery.
  • Retirement and health coverage (based on your region) — build towards your future, your way.

Exact benefits may vary slightly by country. We'll walk through the specifics for your location.

Compensation

This role offers On-Target Earnings (OTE), split between base salary and sales commission. The base salary range is $155,000 - $170,000 USD. Compensation is determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, and qualifications.

🌈 Equal Opportunity Employer

At Buildkite, we value diversity and celebrate all types of skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process.

If you need any accommodations or support during the application or interview process, please reach out to us at accommodations@buildkite.com.

About Contra Labs

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works

This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

  • Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

  • Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

  • Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

  • Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

  • Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

  • Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

  • Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

What We're Looking For

  • Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

jobs.title: Zanda Health: Product Owner
