jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

How you'll make impact

As Airwallex scales globally and prepares for its next stage of growth, you’ll own and evolve the Total Rewards agenda across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking, equity governance and pay transparency.

  • Own and evolve global compensation frameworks, salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, compensation cycles and financial models that support hiring, retention, executive decision-making and international expansion.

  • Build and improve job architecture and leveling frameworks that support organisational scalability, internal equity and talent mobility.

  • Shape regional and global benefits programmes, including plan design, annual renewals, broker and insurer negotiations, benchmarking and cost optimisation, while balancing employee value, fiscal discipline and local market requirements. Hands-on benefits administration isn’t the primary focus of this role.

  • Partner with executive leadership, People Partners and Talent Acquisition to turn complex reward data into clear recommendations, challenge decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data or regulatory requirements, and lead Total Rewards initiatives from scoping and design through implementation.

  • Support international market expansion by developing competitive, compliant and locally relevant compensation and benefits frameworks across global markets.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, ideally within high-growth technology or fintech environments.

  • Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling global compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity structures in hyper-growth organisations.

  • Strong expertise in compensation strategy, including market benchmarking, job and salary architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, and financial modelling.

  • Experience designing benefits programs and leading annual renewals, including broker and insurer negotiations. Hands-on benefits administration is not a primary focus.

  • Practical experience managing compensation planning and equity programs, leading system implementations or migrations, and working with HR technology platforms such as Workday, BambooHR, Carta, Shareworks or Pave.

  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data and financial models into actionable insights and executive recommendations.

  • Proven ability to influence and communicate Total Rewards decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, and Talent Acquisition, demonstrating sound business judgement and confidence in challenging decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data, or regulatory requirements.

  • A builder mindset, with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and develop scalable solutions across global markets and time zones.

Preferred

  • Experience in a late-stage private, pre-IPO, or recently listed company, particularly navigating equity program transformation, strengthening rewards governance, and preparing for public-market readiness.

  • Experience building scalable Total Rewards programs from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with end-to-end ownership and strong accountability.

  • Experience advising C-suite and senior leadership stakeholders on compensation, benefits, equity and rewards governance.

  • Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including scenario modelling and assessment of financial implications.

  • Experience partnering effectively across diverse cultures, functions and international teams, navigating time zones and varying local market requirements.

  • Experience translating complex compensation, benefits and equity concepts into clear, actionable messages for business leaders, People teams and employees.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

Learn more about your team

People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it.

This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Asia
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Your job is to build, lead and scale LemFi’s business across Asia, driving sustainable growth, strong country-level ownership and regional profitability.

As Head of Asia, you will own the regional strategy and commercial performance across China, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh and any new markets launched across the region. You will lead and develop Country Managers, empowering them to own their country-level P&Ls while maintaining accountability for the region’s overall financial performance, growth and profitability.

You will translate LemFi’s broader business objectives into clear regional priorities, ensuring every market has a focused growth strategy, disciplined budget management and measurable commercial targets. You will oversee annual strategic planning, quarterly growth priorities and monthly execution plans, ensuring that country teams remain on track to deliver their targets and adapt quickly when performance or market conditions change.

You’ll combine strategic leadership with hands-on commercial execution. One day, you might be reviewing regional P&L performance and reallocating budgets across markets; the next, coaching a Country Manager on acquisition strategy, evaluating a new market opportunity, negotiating a strategic partnership or addressing a market that is falling behind its growth targets.

You will establish a high-performance operating cadence across the region, using data and commercial insight to identify opportunities, address underperformance, share best practices and allocate resources where they can generate the greatest impact. You will work closely with product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance to ensure that regional plans are supported by the right capabilities and executed effectively.

You own the regional numbers, the performance of your markets and the development of your leaders. Your mission is to make Asia a major engine of sustainable growth and profitability for LemFi.

What you'll build and own

  • Regional P&L and commercial performance. Own the overall Asia regional P&L, with accountability for revenue, transfer volume, gross profit, acquisition costs, retention, operating expenditure and profitability. Translate regional objectives into market-level targets, monitor financial performance and take decisive action to close gaps and improve returns.

  • Country leadership and accountability. Manage, coach and develop Country Managers across China, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh and future markets. Set clear expectations, establish performance standards and ensure each Country Manager has the direction, resources and accountability needed to deliver sustainable growth.

  • Country-level P&L ownership. Empower and enable Country Managers to run their own country P&Ls, make informed commercial decisions and take ownership of their market's financial outcomes. Build their capabilities in budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, channel investment and profitability, while maintaining appropriate regional oversight and alignment.

  • Regional growth strategy and planning. Own the regional growth strategy and oversee the development and execution of annual business plans, quarterly growth plans and monthly operating plans across all markets. Ensure plans are grounded in market opportunity, clear performance targets, realistic budgets and measurable initiatives. Review progress regularly and adjust priorities as needed.

  • Performance management and operating cadence. Establish a consistent rhythm of business reviews across the region, including monthly performance reviews, quarterly planning and regular growth and budget calibration sessions. Track performance against targets, identify risks and opportunities early, and ensure every market has clear actions to address underperformance.

  • Budget allocation and resource optimisation. Oversee regional marketing and growth budgets, ensuring investment is allocated to markets and channels with the strongest potential returns. Identify forecast underspend, evaluate opportunities to accelerate growth and reallocate resources where appropriate to maximise regional impact and new-user acquisition.

  • Market expansion and new-country launches. Identify and evaluate opportunities to expand into new Asian markets. Develop market-entry strategies, assess commercial potential, define investment requirements and coordinate launch plans across product, marketing, operations, compliance and finance. Establish clear launch milestones and ensure new markets have the leadership, infrastructure and commercial plans needed to scale.

  • Customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness. Supervise country-level acquisition strategies across paid and organic channels, partnerships, referrals, community networks and other distribution opportunities. Ensure teams optimise against measurable outcomes, including new users, customer acquisition cost, conversion, transfer volume, retention and lifetime value. Encourage experimentation and the adoption of successful approaches across markets.

  • Strategic partnerships and distribution. Guide Country Managers in identifying, negotiating and developing strategic partnerships that accelerate acquisition and transaction growth. Support high-value regional partnerships where relevant, establish effective commercial frameworks and ensure partnerships translate into measurable business results.

  • Pricing, unit economics and profitability. Oversee market-level pricing strategies and unit economics, ensuring each country balances competitive customer propositions with sustainable margins. Challenge investment decisions, review corridor and channel profitability, and help teams identify opportunities to improve contribution and long-term commercial performance.

  • Market intelligence and competitive strategy. Maintain a strong understanding of customer behaviours, diaspora communities, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations and market-specific opportunities across Asia. Translate market insights into regional priorities and ensure Country Managers adapt their strategies to local customer needs.

  • Cross-functional leadership. Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other central teams to align regional priorities with company-wide objectives. Represent the needs of Asian markets in central planning and ensure teams have the capabilities, resources and support required to execute their growth plans.

  • Leadership development and organisational effectiveness. Build a strong regional leadership team by developing Country Managers into commercially capable, accountable business owners. Establish clear decision-making frameworks, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency and continuous improvement.

  • Executive reporting and strategic decision-making. Provide clear, data-led updates on regional performance, financial forecasts, growth opportunities, key risks and resource requirements. Present recommendations to senior leadership and drive decisions that support LemFi's long-term growth and profitability.

Your experience

  • An experienced regional commercial leader: 10–15 years of experience across fintech, payments, remittances, financial services or high-growth businesses, with a track record of managing substantial commercial targets and preferably multi-market P&L responsibility.

  • A proven people leader: Experience managing senior market leaders, Country Managers or commercial teams across multiple geographies. You know how to set direction, coach leaders, build accountability and create high-performing teams.

  • Strong P&L ownership: Demonstrated experience managing revenue, costs, budgets, forecasts and profitability. You can connect country-level commercial decisions to overall regional financial performance.

  • A strategic growth operator: Experience developing and overseeing annual strategies, quarterly plans and monthly execution priorities. You can translate business objectives into clear plans, measurable targets and consistent delivery.

  • Commercially and analytically sharp: Strong understanding of customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, conversion, gross profit, retention, unit economics and channel performance. You use data to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and make resource-allocation decisions.

  • Experienced in market expansion: A track record of launching, scaling or entering new markets, assessing commercial potential and coordinating cross-functional execution in complex environments.

  • Strong budget and investment management: Experience overseeing multi-market budgets, identifying performance gaps, reallocating investment and balancing growth ambitions with financial discipline.

  • A partnership and distribution builder: Experience developing strategic commercial relationships, negotiating agreements and building acquisition channels that deliver measurable growth.

  • Hands-on and execution-focused: Comfortable moving between regional strategy, financial reviews, leadership coaching and operational problem-solving. You act decisively, take ownership and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

  • A strong cross-functional collaborator: Able to align product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other teams around shared priorities while balancing regional requirements with company-wide objectives.

  • Adaptable across diverse markets: Comfortable operating across different customer segments, cultures, competitive environments and levels of market maturity. Experience across Asian markets or diaspora-focused businesses is an advantage.

  • An accountable and empowering leader: You establish high standards while giving capable teams the autonomy to make decisions. You know when to coach, when to challenge and when to intervene to protect business performance.

Nice to have

  • Remittance and payments experience: Experience scaling international money transfers, cross-border payments or digital wallets, with a strong understanding of FX pricing, corridor economics and customer behaviour.

  • Experience across Asian markets: Existing knowledge of one or more of China, India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh or the Philippines, including relevant customer segments, competitive dynamics and commercial opportunities.

  • Multi-country P&L experience: Previous responsibility for a regional business spanning multiple markets, with a demonstrated ability to balance local market ownership and regional financial objectives.

  • Market launch experience: Experience taking new markets from initial opportunity assessment through launch and into sustainable growth.

  • Diaspora and distribution networks: Relationships with relevant community organisations, student associations, employers, influencers and other distribution partners across key sending and receiving markets.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

jobs.title: comptable clients
jobs.description:
Depuis plus de 44 ans, GROUPE M SERVICE s'est engagé à offrir des services de transport adaptés aux personnes en situation de handicap. Notre société évolue pour devenir un acteur incontournable dans le domaine du transport inclusif, mettant l'accent sur l'accessibilité, le confort et la sécurité.

Notre mission est de faciliter la mobilité des personnes en situation de handicap en offrant des solutions de transport adaptées à leurs besoins spécifiques. Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances en matière de déplacement et nous nous efforçons de créer des expériences de voyage positives pour chacun de nos passagers.

Notre équipe administrative et financière recherche un(e) comptable clients

Vos missions :

Rattaché(e) à la direction administrative et financière, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du cycle clients et intervenez en appui sur les autres travaux comptables.

Comptabilité clients :

  • Elaboration et mise à jour des bordereaux de prix unitaire (BPU).

  • Rédaction des devis de prestations de transport.

  • Mise à jour des grilles tarifaires et suivi des révisions de prix prévues aux contrats.

  • Préparation et émission de la facturation mensuelle des prestations de transport auprès des associations clients, à partir des circuits réalisés.

  • Contrôle de la cohérence des factures (tarifs, avenants, prestations supplémentaires) et émission des avoirs si nécessaires.

  • Remise des factures au factor : préparation des bordereaux de cession, transmission des pièces justificatives et suivi des financements.

  • Suivi du compte courant factor : rapprochement des relevés, contrôle des commissions et frais, suivi des fonds de garanties et réserves.

  • Gestion des créances non garanties, des litiges, des rétrocessions, en lien avec le chargé de compte du factor.

  • Saisie des factures et encaissements (directs et via le factor), lettrage régulier des comptes clients.

  • Suivi des échéances et des retards de paiement, relances écrites et téléphoniques.

  • Analyse et justification des comptes clients et factor, identification des litiges.

  • Interface avec les services administratifs et comptables des clients.

  • Le classement et archivage des pièces comptables.

Votre profil

  • Formation comptable BTS minimum

  • Première expérience réussie de 1 à 3 ans sur un poste similaire

  • Une première expérience dans la gestion d'un contrat d'affacturage serait un plus

  • Aisance avec les chiffres

  • Bonne maîtrise EXCEL

  • La connaissance de Cegid Quadra est un plus

  • Rigueur, organisation et sens de la confidentialité

  • Bon relationnel : vous échangez avec les fournisseurs, les clients et les équipes internes

Ce que nous proposons

  • Contrat : CDI à temps plein 35 h

  • Rémunération : 30 k€ brut annuel

  • Prise de poste : dès que possible

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)

You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.

Why join us?

  • 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.

  • 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.

  • 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.

  • 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

  • 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.

About us – in brief

Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.

Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.

Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

Your Role – What You'll Own

You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.

Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.

Your Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.

Dabei musst du noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, gerne dazulernst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns in die IT-Welt einzutauchen.

Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, hilfst du bei der Fehlersuche und lernst, wie sich technische Störungen systematisch beheben lassen.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen: Du beantwortest IT-Fragen und hilfst dabei, technische Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag zu lösen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich mit IT-Sicherheit: Du erfährst, wie wir unsere Systeme und Daten schützen und warum das für unser Unternehmen so wichtig ist.

  • Du entwickelst dich weiter: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben und kannst dich in spannende IT-Themen und Projekte einbringen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast Interesse an Technik, möchtest verstehen, wie IT-Systeme funktionieren, und probierst gerne Neues aus? Dann bringst du schon eine wichtige Voraussetzung für deine Ausbildung bei uns mit.

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Computer, Netzwerke und digitale Technologien interessieren dich. Vielleicht hast du dich auch privat schon mit dem einen oder anderen IT-Thema beschäftigt.

  • Du gehst Dingen gerne auf den Grund und gibst nicht gleich auf, wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb funktioniert.

  • Du bist offen, hilfsbereit und arbeitest gerne mit anderen Menschen zusammen.

  • Du hast Lust, Neues zu lernen, Fragen zu stellen und dich während deiner Ausbildung weiterzuentwickeln.

Dann könnte unsere studienintegrierende Ausbildung genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Bei der Deutschen Extrakt Kaffee GmbH (DEK) verbindest du eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration mit einem Bachelorstudium der Informatik an der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH).

In Zusammenarbeit mit der BHH bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, innerhalb von vier Jahren einen anerkannten Berufsabschluss und den akademischen Abschluss Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) zu erwerben.

Dabei lernst du unsere IT-Systeme und digitalen Prozesse kennen, sammelst praktische Erfahrungen und vertiefst gleichzeitig dein theoretisches Wissen.

So verbindest du das Beste aus Ausbildung und Studium und legst eine vielseitige Grundlage für deine berufliche Zukunft.

Das erwartet dich in deiner studienintegrierenden Ausbildung

Bei uns lernst du die IT eines international tätigen Unternehmens kennen und erfährst, wie technische Systeme miteinander verbunden sind und im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden.

Dabei wechselst du zwischen drei Lernorten: unserem Unternehmen, der Berufsschule und der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH).

Das bedeutet für dich:

  • Du lernst unsere IT-Welt kennen: Von Computern und Netzwerken über Server bis hin zu komplexeren IT-Systemen erfährst du, wie unsere technische Infrastruktur aufgebaut ist und zusammenarbeitet.

  • Du verbindest Theorie und Praxis: An der BHH beschäftigst du dich mit den wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen der Informatik, während du dein Wissen bei uns im Unternehmen praktisch anwenden und vertiefen kannst.

  • Du bringst Technik zum Laufen: Du unterstützt bei der Einrichtung, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Systeme und lernst, wie wir für einen zuverlässigen IT-Betrieb sorgen.

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Du analysierst technische Störungen, suchst nach Ursachen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team passende Lösungen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich mit IT-Sicherheit: Du erfährst, wie wir unsere Systeme, Netzwerke und Daten schützen und welche Bedeutung IT-Sicherheit für unser Unternehmen hat.

  • Du gestaltest digitale Lösungen mit: Du lernst unsere IT-Prozesse kennen und kannst dich in Projekte einbringen, mit denen wir unsere technische Infrastruktur und digitale Arbeitsabläufe weiterentwickeln.

  • Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben: Mit zunehmendem Wissen und Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben und entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich weiter.

Ausbildung und Studium: So funktioniert das Modell

Mit der studienintegrierenden Ausbildung bieten wir dir gemeinsam mit der Beruflichen Hochschule Hamburg (BHH) einen Bildungsweg, der berufliche Praxis und akademisches Lernen miteinander verbindet.

Das Besondere: Ausbildung und Studium laufen nicht einfach unabhängig voneinander ab, sondern sind inhaltlich und organisatorisch aufeinander abgestimmt.

Während deiner vierjährigen Ausbildungs- und Studienzeit lernst du an drei unterschiedlichen Orten:

  • Bei uns im Unternehmen: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrungen, lernst unsere IT-Abteilung kennen und arbeitest an betrieblichen Aufgaben und Projekten mit.

  • In der Berufsschule: Du erwirbst die beruflichen Fachkenntnisse, die du für deine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration benötigst.

  • An der BHH: Du vertiefst dein Wissen im Bachelorstudiengang Informatik und beschäftigst dich unter anderem mit Programmierung, Mathematik, Softwareentwicklung und IT-Sicherheit.

Die Lernphasen sind aufeinander abgestimmt, sodass du dein Wissen aus den unterschiedlichen Bereichen miteinander verbinden kannst.

Am Ende kannst du gleich zwei Abschlüsse in der Tasche haben: deinen Berufsabschluss als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration und den Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Informatik.

Das bringst du mit

Du möchtest Informatik studieren, gleichzeitig praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und verstehen, wie IT-Lösungen im Unternehmensalltag eingesetzt werden? Dann bringst du schon eine wichtige Voraussetzung mit.

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Du hast die (Fach-)Hochschulreife oder stehst kurz vor deinem Abschluss und erfüllst die Zugangsvoraussetzungen der BHH.

  • Du interessierst dich für Informatik, digitale Technologien und technische Zusammenhänge.

  • Du hast Freude daran, logisch zu denken, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und Lösungen für knifflige Aufgaben zu finden.

  • Du beschäftigst dich gerne mit neuen Themen und bringst die Motivation mit, dich sowohl im Studium als auch in der Praxis weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, bist offen für neue Ideen und scheust dich nicht, Fragen zu stellen.

  • Du kannst dich gut organisieren und bist bereit, die Anforderungen von Ausbildung und Studium miteinander zu verbinden.

Du musst noch kein IT-Profi sein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Computern oder Programmierung sind natürlich hilfreich, aber viel wichtiger sind uns dein Interesse an Informatik, deine Lernbereitschaft und die Freude daran, Neues auszuprobieren.

The role

Forward Deployed Energy Engineers are a new role at Watershed, combining energy and advisory expertise with product-building skills and commercial instinct. You’ll operate at the cutting edge with Watershed customers to build and deploy the next generation of enterprise energy management.

Energy is one of the largest costs on a big company’s P&L and one of its largest sources of emissions. Yet most enterprises have no one who owns how energy is purchased, consumed and reduced across all their sites. Watershed is building the product that changes that, and it’s the company’s biggest bet for its next chapter.

We already help many of the world’s largest companies measure and cut their emissions, and our clean energy business has executed more than $100M in purchases. Now we’re building energy management from zero to one, with engagements underway with a small group of customers today and scaling in 2027.

You’ll work with enterprises that spend tens of millions a year on electricity, embedded in their energy programmes. Starting from the energy data already in Watershed, you’ll find where they’re overspending, deliver the savings, prototype with AI what should become product, and help customers implement solutions, including buying clean power. The goal is an energy programme that wins backing from their CFO and facilities teams. This is a high-ownership role on a small, high-output team, with a direct line to commercial outcomes and real say in what we build. It reports directly to Watershed’s head of energy and decarbonization.

What you'll do

  • Deliver energy engagements with measurable results: Run deep engagements with a handful of customers at a time: change tariffs, upgrade equipment, find and cut waste, and show the savings.

  • Win customers who vouch for us: Earn the trust of facilities and finance leads so they would tell a peer to work with Watershed.

  • Turn what works into product: Spot the problems that repeat across customers, prototype with AI, and work with our engineers to build an AI-led product for many.

  • Close clean energy deals: Help customers sign deals with existing clean power products (eg EACs, fixed-price VPPAs), yourself or alongside our account teams.

  • Make the team smarter on energy: Be the person colleagues go to on tariffs, loads and what actually cuts a bill.

You might be a fit if you

  • Know how commercial and industrial sites use and buy energy (tariffs, loads, HVAC and controls, procurement) from time at an ESCO, an energy consultancy, an engineering firm or an energy-tech company.

  • Have built things: scripts, models, prototypes or AI-assisted workflows, and can show us one. Prototype-quality code is enough; moving fast matters most.

  • Are fluent with data tools (Excel, SQL or Python) and LLM tools, and can turn messy meter and bill data into something a customer acts on.

  • Have run client work from scoping to outcome, and are as credible with a facilities manager as with a CFO.

  • Can tell a compelling story with data, from raw numbers to insight to a recommendation someone signs off. You've originated work or supported deals, and want to get better at selling.

  • Are energised to build a new product and service, to be on the front lines of building a new business, and to leave a legacy as part of a fast-moving team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with clean power deals (PPAs, VPPAs, fixed-price power contracts, and energy attribute certificates like RECs, GOs and REGOs).

  • Hands-on work with utility bill, half-hourly or building management system data.

  • A few years in consulting or advisory.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

Responsable Revenue Operations / Head of RevOps (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Votre mission :

Le Responsable Revenue Operations est essentiel à l’optimisation et l’accélération de nos activités Revenue. Ce poste reporte directement au Chief Sales Officer. Il gère de manière stratégique et opérationnelle, le design et la mise en place de la transformation de l’organisation (design d’organisation, systèmes et processus) tout en devenant le point de contact principal du pilotage des activités. Il porte la roadmap Revenue et en assure la mise en œuvre sur l'ensemble de la chaîne commerciale, de la génération de leads à la fidélisation client. Il arbitre les priorités entre activité courante et projets structurants, pilote les chantiers de bout en bout et rend compte de leur impact sur la performance. 

Le poste combine trois dimensions : le pilotage de projets, le management d'une équipe de trois personnes réparties sur les équipes métier, et une composante technique forte sur le CRM, l'automatisation et l'analyse stratégique de la donnée. 

Vos activités :

Roadmap et pilotage de projets 

  • Construire et maintenir la roadmap Revenue, en arbitrant les priorités avec la direction commerciale 

  • Piloter les projets du cadrage à la mise en production, en garantissant les jalons et les livrables 

  • Protéger la capacité dédiée aux projets structurants face aux sollicitations quotidiennes 

  • Assurer le pilotage du projet de refonte CRM, chantier majeur de la période à venir 

  • Gestion des prestataires Revenue (Logiciel, conseil, strategie…) 

Processus revenus et performance 

  • Concevoir, documenter et faire adopter les processus sur l'ensemble du cycle revenu afin d’homogénéiser, accélérer et optimiser les cycles 

  • Définir et opérationnaliser la gestion des territoires : découpage, règles d'attribution des comptes, dimensionnement des portefeuilles 

  • Structurer les règles de qualification, de routage et de scoring des leads 

  • Fiabiliser le pilotage du pipeline et la prévision commerciale : définition des étapes, critères de sortie, hygiène des opportunités 

  • Suivre les indicateurs de conversion, de durée de cycle, de taux de transformation et d'attrition, et identifier les points de friction 

  • Définir des objectifs mesurables et suivre les indicateurs de performance pour toutes les équipes Revenue (Marketing, Sales, Client Success, SDRs). 

  • Supporter les activités liées au planning commercial (Bottom up forecast, analyses, design des modèles de compensation, objectifs annuels, headcount…) 

  • Supporter les activités de formation et de développement professionnel des équipes Revenue  

CRM, données et pilotage 

  • Assurer la gouvernance du CRM : modèle de données, droits et profils, cohérence des référentiels, budget 

  • Garantir la qualité de la donnée commerciale et mettre en place les contrôles associés 

  • Produire et industrialiser les tableaux de bord de pilotage pour la direction et les responsables d'équipe 

  • Déployer un dispositif d'autonomie des utilisateurs : modèles de rapports réutilisables, formation, référents identifiés par équipe 

Automatisation et intelligence artificielle 

  • Identifier les tâches manuelles à fort volume et concevoir les automatisations correspondantes 

  • Intégrer les outils d'intelligence artificielle dans les processus opérationnels des équipes revenus (Sales CSM et Marketing) 

  • Évaluer, sélectionner et rationaliser les outils du périmètre 

Management 

  • Encadrer une équipe de trois personnes, chacune rattachée à une branche revenue 

  • Organiser la répartition de la charge et le suivi des priorités 

  • Faire monter l'équipe en compétence et assurer la cohérence des pratiques 

La rémunération sur ce poste est de 80K€ fixe annuelle + une partie variable allant jusqu’à 10K€ annuel en fonction des objectifs.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Profil hybride, à la fois technique, stratégique et opérationnel. 

Compétences indispensables 

  • Salesforce : maîtrise du modèle de données, du Flow Builder et de l'administration courante. 

  • Pilotage de projet : capacité à cadrer, orchestrer et démontrer l'impact des chantiers livrés. 

  • Intelligence artificielle : capacité à intégrer les outils dans des processus opérationnels, au-delà d'un usage ponctuel. 

  • Stratégie commerciale : capacite à analyser les données commerciales en profondeur afin de déterminer les contraintes et les opportunités de croissance ainsi que les leviers Revenue a exploiter. 

Compétences techniques 

  • Administration de CRM : Salesforce, HubSpot 

  • Automatisation : n8n, Make ou équivalents 

  • Intelligence artificielle : Claude, Codex ou équivalents 

  • Restitution de la donnée : Salesforce, Power BI (Fabric ou Databricks appréciés) 

 Expérience 

  • 8 ans d'expérience minimum, sur un périmètre Revenue Operations ou Sales Operations  

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans la vente et/ou la relation client, qui donne la connaissance du terrain et la crédibilité nécessaire face aux équipes 

  • Une première expérience d'encadrement constitue un atout 

  • Formation en business management (Master, MBA) est un atout 

Qualités attendues 

  • Capacité d'arbitrage et de priorisation dans un environnement à fortes sollicitations 

  • Aisance dans le dialogue avec des interlocuteurs commerciaux comme techniques 

  • Orientation résultats : mesurer l'impact de ce qui est livré

  • Poste basé à Issy-les-moulineaux

  • Rémunération fixe entre 80K€ et 90K€ en fonction du profil et un variable allant jusqu’à 10K€ sur objectifs

The role:

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois

Lieu de travail : Douai (59)

 

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

 

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

 

Contexte scientifique et missions :

 

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.

Le projet européen THERMOHARV, réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants, capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone, présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe (Direct Ink Writing, DIW).

L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés.

Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes :

  1. Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés.

  2. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres.

  3. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée.

  4. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques.

  5. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible.

 

Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype, au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif.


Profil de la personne recrutée :

 

La personne recrutée devra être étudiante en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivre une formation équivalente dans le domaine de la science et du génie des matériaux, de la physicochimie ou du génie des procédés.

Des connaissances en formulation et dispersion d’encres, notamment par ultrasons, en fabrication additive (impression 3D, écriture directe) ainsi qu’en caractérisation des matériaux (rhéologie, goniométrie, profilométrie) seront particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le domaine de la thermoélectricité constitueront un atout supplémentaire.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, la personne recrutée devra faire preuve de rigueur scientifique, d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’un intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale. De bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication scientifique, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, sont également attendues.

jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.

Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.


The role

Join Aquablu’s Enterprise team, the group behind our largest and most ambitious multi-country deals, and lead something brand new: bringing Aquablu to gym chains across Europe. You’ll work directly with our founder and CCO, Marc van Zuylen.

You won’t be starting from zero. We already have great early traction with large chains like SportCity and with smaller operators across Europe. Your mission is to turn that momentum into a thriving book of business: premium chains and ambitious challengers, decided at HQ, spanning multiple clubs and countries.

This is a true builder role, and that’s what makes it exciting. There’s no finished playbook yet; you get to write it. You’ll own the vertical end-to-end. You’ll close the deals and shape how we sell. You’ll build relationships from HQ procurement to regional operations to the club managers on the floor. And you’ll leave behind a repeatable engine the next hire can run with.

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor who loves being both player and orchestrator. You’ll carry a meaningful enterprise number, bring a multi-layered buying committee along with you, and build the motion while live deals are moving. You won’t manage a team or simply hunt for new logos. You’ll get to build something lasting at a company that’s growing fast.


What you’ll own

  • Open and own the gym-chain vertical across Europe. A portfolio of named premium and experience-led chains plus the sharpest smaller operators — multi-club footprints, multiple markets, HQ decisioning with local activation.

  • Chain stakeholder orchestration. Build relationships at HQ (procurement, ops, member experience, sustainability), regional (country managers, operations leads), and club level (general managers who make it happen on the floor). All three layers simultaneously.

  • The chain playbook — from scratch. Document the repeatable motion through live deals. Pricing structures for multi-site rollouts, member-experience positioning, ops integration, QBRs with HQ. Partner with RevOps to turn it into a predictable engine.


What good looks like

  • A validated chain pipeline — a clear book of gym-chain accounts across Europe, multi-country deals progressing through stages

  • Systematic HQ-to-club orchestration, not opportunistic — cadence with chain HQ, regional co-sell in flight, club-level activation live

  • Forecast discipline as a differentiator — your chain forecast is the most accurate view in the GTM org, not the most optimistic

  • A playbook the next hire can run — so the vertical scales beyond you


About you

  • 5+ years B2B enterprise sales, proven track record in the Gym vertical in EU.

  • Chain experience is a must — you have sold to, or inside, multi-site chain operators . Experience with large European chains

  • Premium / experience-led fluency — you understand why member experience, brand and sustainability move the needle, and can speak the language of ops and marketing leaders, not just procurement

  • Subscription or hardware-enabled-SaaS background — you understand recurring revenue, not one-off CapEx sales

  • Builder mindset — you’ve been a first-market or founding seller before. Opening a vertical from scratch and codifying the motion at the same time energises you

  • AI-native sales practitioner — you’ve rewired how you sell over the last 12 months and lead that shift rather than resist it

jobs.title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
jobs.description:
Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) für agentische Softwareentwicklung

Die Kanzlei Prinz ist auf Online-Reputationsrecht spezialisiert: Für über 2.300 Mandanten, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen, sorgen wir dafür, dass rechtswidrige Bewertungen auf Plattformen wie kununu, Google und Trustpilot verschwinden. Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System.

Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung

So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum.

Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus.

Warum wir dich suchen

Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut gefülltes Backlog haben wir. Derzeit setzen wir drei bis fünf Verbesserungen pro Tag um. Mit einer Entwicklerin oder einem Entwickler in Vollzeit wollen wir die Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen – durchdacht, getestet und passend zur bestehenden Architektur. Die fachliche Richtung ist klar – die technisch saubere Umsetzung liegt bei dir. Kein Beratungsgeschäft, keine wechselnden Kundenprojekte: Du entwickelst für dein eigenes Team und siehst jeden Tag, wie deine Software die Arbeit erleichtert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Agentische Softwareentwicklung (dein Schwerpunkt): Du entwickelst unser Case-Management-System weiter (Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure) – mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code: Du schreibst Spezifikationen, lässt die Agenten umsetzen, prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch und bringst es sicher in den Live-Betrieb.

  • Deterministisch statt KI im Ablauf: Was sich mit klassischer Software lösen lässt, setzt du ohne KI um – mit festen Regeln und prüfbarer Logik.

  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierung: Du bindest Systeme per API und Webhook an, etwa Microsoft 365, lexoffice und das besondere elektronische Anwaltspostfach (beA), und überführst bestehende Power-Automate-Flows in Azure Functions.

  • Anforderungen aufnehmen: Du hörst unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen genau zu, verstehst ihre Abläufe und übersetzt ihre Anliegen in klare Lösungen. Die Prioritäten stimmst du mit Matthias Prinz ab.

  • Betrieb & Qualität: Du sicherst deine Arbeit mit automatisierten Tests ab, behältst Logs und Schnittstellen im Blick und findest bei Störungen systematisch die Ursache. Pflege und Fehlerbehebung gehören genauso dazu wie neue Funktionen.

  • Schulung: Du stellst neue Funktionen im Team vor und schulst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang damit.

Wir bieten:

  • Klare Rolle: Eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung – du arbeitest direkt mit dem Kanzleiinhaber zusammen, der deine Sprache spricht. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen.

  • Gepflegte Codebasis: Automatisierte Tests, Typprüfung und dokumentierte Architektur – kein Altsystem aus den 90ern.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Die Kanzleiprozesse lernst du über unsere Schulungsplattform mit Checklisten und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen kennen.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Anstellung von Anfang an.

  • Harmonisches Miteinander: Ein eingespieltes, derzeit überwiegend weibliches Team, in dem man sich aufeinander verlassen kann – in hellen, modernen Büros am Mainzer Rheinufer.

  • Gleitzeit und gutes Gehalt


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger mit entsprechenden Fachkenntnissen sind ebenso willkommen

  • Erfahrung mit agentischer Softwareentwicklung (z. B. mit Claude Code) – für uns zentral: Du gibst KI-Agenten präzise Vorgaben, zerlegst Aufgaben in überschaubare Schritte und prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Python, SQL (idealerweise Microsoft SQL Server), React/TypeScript und REST-APIs – aus dem Beruf, einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder eigenen Projekten

  • Von Vorteil: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 (Graph API, Entra ID), Docker, Git und CI/CD

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und Freude daran, Abläufe zu ordnen und Schritt für Schritt zu verbessern

  • Geduld und ein offenes Ohr: Du erklärst Technik so, dass sie auch Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne IT-Hintergrund verstehen

  • Sensibilität für Datenschutz und Berufsgeheimnis: Wir setzen nur Datenverarbeiter ein, die den Anforderungen des § 203 StGB und der DSGVO genügen – das berücksichtigst du bei jeder Architektur- und Tool-Entscheidung

  • Zuverlässige, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise – was du zusagst, hältst du ein

  • Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • Juristische Kenntnisse sind nicht nötig – die fachlichen Regeln bringen wir dir bei

Du arbeitest gern gründlich, baust lieber Software, die zuverlässig läuft, als Software, die nur beeindruckt – und freust dich, wenn dein Team damit leichter arbeitet? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Product Lead

Product Lead


About Us

Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics.

That’s why we're building the autonomous supply chain: AI workers that support their human co-workers and coordinate the work across company boundaries. We automate workflows first, then connect trading partners, and finally orchestrate entire supply chain networks.

As former logistics operators, we understand this industry inside out: its complexity, exceptions and the realities of running a low-margin business. We are backed by leading European investors and are building a new category for the global logistics industry.

The Role

As our Product Lead, you will shape our platform strategy and own the product roadmap from first insight to shipped feature.

We are building a scalable platform, not a services business. Every customer project teaches us something, and your job is to turn those lessons into platform capabilities that make the next customer faster and cheaper to onboard. You will decide what becomes a configurable platform feature and what we deliberately don't build into the platform.

Tasks

Our product:

Logistica is offering a flexible platform that lets logistics teams automate document-based workflows. Our focus use case is simplifying the load carrier management (pallets, crates, etc.) for wholesalers and logistics service providers. From this niche we are expanding to adjacent use cases that cover post- and pre-shipment operations. Currently the platform combines unstructured data sources, automates workflows and helps connecting partners. It’s built upon the following principles:

  • An AI-first approach to solve operational problems

  • A flexible platform built for how logistics actually operates

  • Built-in network features that help customers optimize across company boundaries

What you will do:

  • Define what is a platform feature vs. a configuration vs. a customization. Our customers value our platform’s flexibility, but you help to strike the balance between scalability and speed

  • Filter customer requests. You look past individual customer requests to the problem behind them, define the solution and ship it in steps that build on each other

  • Drive self-service functionality. Enable non-technical operators to set up and optimize workflow automations without engineering assistance

  • Design how our AI workers work. You go deep on how operators run load carrier accounts, document flows and exceptions. Then you translate that into agent behavior, extraction logic, human-in-the-loop flows and evals.

  • Drive the roadmap end to end. You pull together input from customers, CS, sales and engineering, force the prioritization calls and write specs engineers want to build from.

  • Stay close to users. You visit customers regularly in their warehouses, admin offices and HQs across Europe

  • Make the product sellable. You shape the product narrative with sales, support key demos and feed market learnings back into our playbooks

Requirements

  • +3 years experience in product (AI, B2B software, tech platform businesses)

  • Technical background or deep technical understanding

  • Communicate clearly to diverse audiences

  • Early stage experience

  • German at C1 level, English for working in an international team

  • Open to customer visits across Europe

Benefits

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Lifecycle Manager with strong hands-on expertise in traditional IT infrastructure, legacy platforms, and Nutanix environments.

The role involves managing the complete infrastructure lifecycle across industrial and manufacturing environments, including infrastructure assessments, technology refreshes, hardware deployments, virtualization, migrations, upgrades, and infrastructure modernization.

•Prepare implementation plans, migration procedures, cutover plans, and operational handover documentation.

Essential Technical Skills & Experience

•Strong hands-on experience in IT infrastructure lifecycle management.

•Practical experience with traditional/legacy infrastructure and Nutanix platforms.

•Experience with Nutanix cluster administration, node expansion, upgrades, migrations, and capacity management.

•Strong understanding of virtualization technologies, compute, storage, and server infrastructure.

•Understanding of enterprise networking, physical connectivity, cabling, and infrastructure hardware.
